title: Welcome to Agentero
subtitle: Read papers and take notes alongside your AI assistant. A few quick steps to set up your workspace.

theme.title: Pick your look
theme.desc: Choose a color scheme you like — you can change it anytime in Settings.

agent.title: Choose your AI assistant
agent.desc: Agentero plugs into agents already installed on this computer to summarize papers and answer questions — no extra API keys, just pick one.
agent.none: No agents found yet. Install one on this computer (e.g. opencode or claude-acp), then click Rescan.

translate.title: Set up translation
translate.desc: Select text in foreign-language papers to translate it instantly. The built-in option works out of the box.
translate.configureOwn: I have my own translation API
translate.probeFail: Check your key and try again

layout.title: Spot figures and formulas automatically
layout.desc: Automatically locate figures, tables and formulas in your PDFs. The free on-device model works out of the box; a cloud API gets even better results.
layout.probeFail: Check your key and try again

vault.title: Create your library
vault.desc: A vault is just a plain folder on your computer where papers and notes live. You can create or switch to another one anytime.

sidebar.title: Your vault, your files
sidebar.desc: Each paper is a plain folder with its PDF, notes and LaTeX source — Obsidian, VS Code and Git can take over anytime.

magicWand.title: One-click import
magicWand.desc: Paste a DOI, arXiv ID or link; metadata, PDF and LaTeX source are fetched automatically. {{magicWandShortcut}} opens it anytime.

workspace.title: Split-screen reading
workspace.desc: Papers open with the PDF on the left and notes on the right. Select text to highlight, annotate, translate or ask.

agent.title: Your agent, ready to help
agent.desc: Reuses your locally signed-in agent — no API keys. The current paper joins the context automatically; click a suggested question to summarize it.

titlebar.title: That's it!
titlebar.desc: Toggle panels here. {{settingsShortcut}} opens Settings, {{quickOpenShortcut}} jumps anywhere. Tutorial notes were created in your vault — start there.
